name: open-code-review
tagline: Battle-tested AI code review CLI from Alibaba
description: open-code-review is an AI code review CLI that Alibaba open-sourced after two years of internal use at massive scale — tens of thousands of developers and millions of defects caught. It uses a hybrid architecture that combines a deterministic pipeline (precise file selection, smart file bundling, fine-grained rule matching) with an LLM agent for deeper analysis. Built-in rulesets cover NPE, thread-safety, XSS, and SQL injection, and it is compatible with both OpenAI and Anthropic backends, including a plugin for Claude Code. The design specifically addresses the classic agent review failure modes: incomplete coverage, position drift, and unstable quality.
highlights: Hybrid deterministic pipeline plus LLM agent for precise, stable reviews
Battle-tested at Alibaba across tens of thousands of developers for two years
Built-in rulesets for NPE, thread-safety, XSS, and SQL injection
Works with OpenAI and Anthropic backends, including a Claude Code plugin
Tackles incomplete coverage, position drift, and unstable quality head-on
curatorNote: AI code review tools are everywhere, but almost none have been hardened by two years inside Alibaba. The deterministic-plus-LLM hybrid is the pragmatic architecture the space needs — rules catch what rules catch, and the agent handles the rest.
